summary: Evaxion A/S, a Danish clinical-stage TechBio company listed on Nasdaq (EVAX), furnished a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report) containing a press release announcing its 2027 financial calendar. The release lists reporting dates: full-year 2026 results and business update on March 4, 2027, the Annual General Meeting on April 29, 2027, and quarterly updates on May 4, August 19, and November 18, 2027. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is disclosed. This is a routine calendar/AGM notice, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
